rows.headcount_source_title: Department of the Interior — About / Employees
rows.headcount_quote: Interior employs about 70,000 people in nine technical bureaus.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Large field/seasonal workforce in NPS/BLM/FWS pulls average down; HQ scientists/admin push partially up.

rows.headcount_quote: The BLM has a workforce of more than 10,000 employees.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Predominantly field staff (range, recreation, fire); ~20% HQ/state-office knowledge work eligible.

rows.headcount_quote: More than 20,000 employees work in the National Park Service.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Rangers, maintenance, interpretation — predominantly field; small HQ/regional admin tier.

rows.headcount_quote: USGS has approximately 8,000 employees, primarily scientists.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Predominantly research scientists, modelers, GIS — heavy knowledge work suited for LLM use.

rows.headcount_quote: BIA employs roughly 4,500 staff supporting tribal governments.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Mix of program administration / case management (eligible) and field social services.

rows.headcount_quote: USDA has approximately 100,000 employees.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Heavy field/inspection (FSIS, APHIS, FS) offset by large research/admin and county-office knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: The Forest Service employs more than 35,000 people.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Largely wildland fire, recreation, timber, field crews; small HQ research/admin eligible.

rows.headcount_quote: FSA has approximately 11,000 employees in county and state offices.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: County-office program technicians handle loans, payments, eligibility — desk-bound knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: FNS has approximately 1,500 employees administering nutrition assistance programs.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Headquarters/regional program staff — policy, grants, compliance review.

rows.headcount_quote: ARS has approximately 8,000 employees including 2,000 scientists.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Research scientists + lab support — strong knowledge-work profile.

rows.headcount_quote: DOE has approximately 16,000 federal employees and supports more than 95,000 contractor staff at national labs.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Federal workforce is heavily HQ/program/scientific; lab contractors (researchers) not counted in FTE.
rows.notes: FTE excludes ~95,000 M&O contractor staff at national labs.

rows.headcount_quote: NNSA has approximately 1,900 federal employees and 60,000 contractors at its nuclear security enterprise sites.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Federal NNSA staff are policy/program/oversight — desk knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: EERE has approximately 700 federal staff managing clean-energy R&D.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Policy, program, technical analysis — knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: DOE Office of Science federal staff (~1,000–1,200) oversee 10 national labs and 28,000 researchers.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Federal staff are program managers / scientists overseeing research portfolios.
rows.notes: Used as national-labs aggregate stand-in; lab researchers are contractor-employed.

rows.headcount_quote: Commerce has approximately 50,000 employees across NOAA, Census, NIST, PTO and other bureaus.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Heavy science/legal/economics workforce (PTO examiners, NIST, NOAA, Census).

rows.headcount_quote: NIST employs about 3,400 scientists, engineers, technicians, and support staff.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Predominantly research scientists/engineers; knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: NOAA has more than 12,000 civilian employees plus the NOAA Commissioned Officer Corps.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Mix of research scientists (eligible) and operational/shipboard/weather forecasters (24x7 ops).

rows.headcount_quote: The Census Bureau has approximately 4,500 permanent full-time employees.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Statisticians, demographers, IT — desk knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: USPTO has approximately 14,000 employees, including more than 8,500 patent examiners.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Patent/trademark examiners + attorneys + IT — entirely knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: DOT has approximately 55,000 employees across its operating administrations.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: FAA air-traffic controllers (~14k) and safety inspectors pull down; engineering / HQ knowledge work pushes up.

rows.headcount_quote: FAA has more than 45,000 employees including approximately 14,000 air traffic controllers and 8,000 aviation safety inspectors.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Air traffic controllers (~0.10) + inspectors (~0.20) dominate; engineering/HQ are eligible (~0.85).

rows.headcount_quote: FHWA has approximately 2,800 employees.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Engineers, planners, grant managers — primarily knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: NHTSA has approximately 700 employees.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Engineers, researchers, regulators, defects investigators — desk-based knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: DOL has approximately 15,000 employees.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Mostly investigators, economists, policy/legal/admin — knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: BLS has approximately 2,100 employees, primarily economists and statisticians.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Statistical / analytical knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: OSHA has approximately 2,200 federal staff including compliance safety and health officers.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Compliance officers split between field inspections (eligible only via mobile) and HQ/regional desk work.

rows.headcount_quote: ETA has approximately 1,100 federal employees administering workforce programs.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Grants / policy / administration — desk knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: The Department of Education has approximately 4,400 employees.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Predominantly policy, grants, research, OCR investigators — knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: FSA has approximately 1,400 employees managing the federal student aid portfolio.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Contract management, oversight, customer service — knowledge work with significant ops component.

rows.headcount_quote: The Department of State has approximately 77,000 employees including ~14,000 Foreign Service, ~11,000 Civil Service, and ~52,000 Locally Employed Staff.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: FS/CS (~25k) are strong LLM users; LE staff (~52k) mixed — many admin/eligible, some operational.

rows.headcount_quote: The Foreign Service has approximately 14,000 members including Foreign Service Officers and Specialists.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: FSOs are heavy desk knowledge users; already significant StateChat adoption.
rows.notes: Using FSI slug as proxy for the Foreign Service workforce (no dedicated slug).

rows.headcount_quote: Consular Affairs is among the largest bureaus, with approximately 14,000 employees worldwide.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Visa/passport adjudication is desk knowledge work; some operational windows.

rows.headcount_quote: Treasury has approximately 100,000 employees, the vast majority at IRS.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: IRS dominates; revenue agents + admin eligible (~0.60); BEP/Mint production lower; OCC/FinCEN very high.

rows.headcount_quote: The IRS has approximately 85,000 employees.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Revenue agents + customer service + IT eligible; large submission-processing/mail-handling workforce less so.
rows.notes: Post-IRA hiring; declines projected under FY26 RIFs.

rows.headcount_quote: The OCC has approximately 3,500 employees, primarily bank examiners.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Bank examiners are knowledge workers; analysis-heavy.

rows.headcount_quote: FinCEN has approximately 400 employees.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Financial intelligence analysts and regulatory staff — full knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: The U.S. Mint has approximately 1,600 employees across its production facilities and headquarters.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Predominantly manufacturing/production; HQ + sales is eligible.

rows.headcount_source_title: Bureau of Engraving and Printing — About
rows.headcount_quote: BEP has approximately 1,800 employees at its DC and Fort Worth currency-production facilities.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Predominantly currency-production blue collar; small HQ/engineering eligible.

rows.headcount_quote: EPA has approximately 16,000 employees at HQ, 10 regional offices, and labs.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Scientists, engineers, attorneys, regulators — predominantly knowledge work.

rows.headcount_quote: HUD has approximately 8,400 employees.
rows.ai_eligible_rationale: Almost entirely program/grants/policy/legal/admin — knowledge work.
